expressions.description: Binary arithmetic, logical, or comparison operation
expressions.rules: Strict type matching; arithmetic between String and Int requires explicit formatting or parsing.

expressions.description: Functional pipeline operator passing LHS as the first argument of RHS
expressions.rules: RHS must resolve to a callable function.

expressions.description: Pattern matching expression over enums, variants, or values
expressions.rules: Must be exhaustive across all enum variants or include a wildcard `_` arm.

expressions.description: Invokes a function or method with argument list
expressions.rules: Argument count and types must strictly match function parameters.

expressions.description: Accesses a field or method on an object instance
expressions.rules: Null-safe navigation operator `?.` should be used on optional types.
